title: De Vermiis Mysteriis

'''De Vermiis Mysteriis''' is a [[unique item]].  It first appeared in the [[Dunwich Horror]] expansion.

==Card info==
'''Type''': [[Tome]]

'''Arkham Encounters''': Exhaust and spend 2 [[movement]] points to make a [[Lore check|Lore (-2) check]].  If you pass, close 1 open [[gate]] (it cannot be sealed) anywhere in Arkham (whether or not you've explored it), lose 1 [[Sanity]], and discard De Vermis Mysteriis.

'''Price''': $5

==Mythos Source==

De Vermiis Mysteriis first appeared in ''The Shambler from the Stars'' (1935), written by Robert Bloch.
